# Finmei

Finmei is an invoicing tool designed to simplify billing processes, allowing users to create and manage invoices and track expenses efficiently.

Category: Finance. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/finmei/.

## Actions

- **Create Invoice**: Create a new invoice.
- **Delete Customer**: Delete a specific customer by their ID.
- **Delete Invoice**: Delete an invoice.
- **Delete Payment**: Delete a payment.
- **Delete Product**: Delete a product by its ID.
- **Get Payment** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific payment by its ID.
- **Get Product by ID** (read-only): Retrieve a product by its ID.
- **List Currencies** (read-only): List all currencies supported by Finmei.
- **List Customers** (read-only): List all customers with optional filters and pagination.
- **List Invoices** (read-only): List invoices.
- **List Payments** (read-only): Retrieve a list of payments.
- **List Products** (read-only): Retrieve a list of products with optional filters and pagination.
- **Update Customer**: Update an existing customer's details.
- **Update Product**: Update an existing product's details.
